issues.detail: The Hebrew text does not mention that Hadoram brought the gold, silver, and bronze vessels; it says 'and all the vessels of gold, silver, and bronze' as part of the tribute sent by Toi (the father of Hadoram), but the Chinese adds '哈多蘭帶來' (Hadoram brought), which is an addition not present in the Hebrew. The Hebrew simply states 'and all the vessels of gold, silver, and bronze' as an object of the sending, not explicitly that Hadoram brought them.
